feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: JPMorgan Chase faces £100m-plus tax bill from Healey raid
articles.summary: JPMorgan Chase will pay additional taxes of between £100m and £150m as a result of the corporation tax surcharge hike announced by John Healey in his budget on Wednesday - a bill which could renew doubts about the construction of its new London headquarters.

articles.title: Ofwat hands EY £15m contract to monitor troubled Thames Water
articles.summary: EY, the big four accountancy firm, has landed a £15m contract to supervise Thames Water, the troubled water utility which stands on the brink of collapse.

articles.title: Ex-City minister raises millions for insurance AI start-up i23
articles.summary: A former City minister has raised millions of pounds in funding for an AI-driven start-up which will target the vast global insurance broking market.

articles.title: Main budget announcements at a glance
articles.summary: Chancellor John Healey has unveiled the long-anticipated budget, the first for Prime Minister Andy Burnham.

articles.title: Virgin Atlantic fury as Heathrow forces Delta terminal move
articles.summary: Virgin Atlantic Airways has reacted furiously after Heathrow Airport decided to force its joint venture partner to relocate to another terminal - a move it warned would risk driving fares up for passengers.

articles.title: Poundland close to collapse as new directors head for exit
articles.summary: The directors recruited to steer Poundland through its emergency sale process less than two weeks ago are on the brink of resigning, heightening the risk that one of Britain's biggest discount retailers will collapse within days, risking thousands of job losse

articles.title: Another major lender's profits in billions as higher bank tax expected in budget
articles.summary: Another of the UK's biggest banks has posted billions in profits in part thanks to higher interest rates.

articles.title: Microsoft offers 'buyouts' to 60,000 staff including UK workers
articles.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance packages to 60,000 of its staff - more than a quarter of its workforce - including some in the UK.

articles.title: Curzon Cinemas-owner Fortress screen-tests potential bidders
articles.summary: The owner of Curzon Cinemas is exploring a sale of the business following a number of unsolicited bid approaches.

articles.title: Anthropic reveals plans for blockbuster IPO
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic, the company behind the popular Claude chatbot, has filed papers to sell shares to the public for the first time.
